builds.name: Lightforge starter
builds.goal: Three Lightforge pieces grant 18 Spell Power. Pair them with a two-handed sword, melee crit, and gear that supports Holy damage.
builds.talents: Take Seal of Command for Vengeance. Champion of the Light adds spell damage from Intellect.
builds.requirements: Level 60. Train two-handed swords. The Alliance libram comes from your Paladin crafting route.
